scientific_interpretation: Binding Evaluation Finding: The relation linear probe reaches 99.5% accuracy on dev. However, on the paired relational-binding probe (testing whether the boundary representation assigns higher projection score to the bound target value over an alternative value of the same relation), accuracy is 47.50% (Chance = 50.0%). This demonstrates that relational binding is NOT robustly established at the generation boundary; the representation primarily carries generic relation-type information without specific compositional value binding.
